title: Retries, alerts, task SLAs, and the pipeline that failed at 3am

videos.script: Three in the morning. The price API is down, and nobody is awake. {{night}} Ana's DAG tries again. Fifteen seconds, then thirty, then a minute, then two. {{tries}} Two minutes after the run was queued, a line says it is late. It is still trying. {{late}} After the fifth try, a second line says it has failed, and why. {{failed}} In the morning she reads both lines, asks the API herself, and gets a 503. {{read}} When it answers again, she clears the task. One more try, and the night's prices are in. {{clear}} Not every failure deserves a retry. A wrong key fails at once, and says so. And a DAG that does not import never fails at all. It simply never runs.
